v2.feedback: The moiré-to-standing-wave concept is genuinely strong — columnar breath-harmonics read as vertical organ pipes and the chain from qwf's swerve is legible. The standing-wave visibility envelope (band * fall * standingWave) may produce columns that read more as density variation than as distinct architectural forms at default camera distance; consider tightening the band smoothstep (e.g. smoothstep(0.10, 0.30, f)) so columns separate more crisply, and adding a slight radial contraction for particles inside high-field bands to give each column a tighter waist. The upward breath-drift mod-wrap at y could cause visible popping when particles teleport from top to bottom — a fade-out alpha near the top and fade-in near the bottom would mask the seam.
